Share the cold receipe of tea

Here's how to make a refreshing **cold herbal infusion**:

**Cold Brew Method (Best for flavor):**
1. Steep 1 teabag or 2-3 flowers in a cup of warm water for 30-40 seconds.
2. Let it cool to room temperature.
3. Pour over ice and chill in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours.
4. Add honey, lemon, or ginger for extra flavor and wellness boost.

**Quick Chill Method:**
Brew your herbal infusion as usual, then immediately pour over ice. Add your favorite natural sweetener and citrus.

**Pro Tips:**
Use [**Ball Tea Infuser**](https://bluetea.co.in/products/ball-tea-infuser) or [**Basket Tea Infuser**](https://bluetea.co.in/products/bucket-tea-infuser) for loose flowers. Serve in our [**Glass Crystal Tea Cups**](https://bluetea.co.in/products/blue-tea-cup-pack-of-2) for an elegant experience.

All seven herbal infusions in your combo work beautifully cold. Hibiscus and Rose are especially refreshing chilled!

Share the cold receipe of tea

Here's how to make a refreshing **cold herbal infusion**:

**Cold Brew Method (Best for flavor):**
1. Steep 1 teabag or 2-3 flowers in a cup of warm water for 30-40 seconds.
2. Let it cool to room temperature.
3. Pour over ice and chill in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours.
4. Add honey, lemon, or ginger for extra flavor and wellness boost.

**Quick Chill Method:**
Brew your herbal infusion as usual, then immediately pour over ice. Add your favorite natural sweetener and citrus.

**Pro Tips:**
Use [**Ball Tea Infuser**](https://bluetea.co.in/products/ball-tea-infuser) or [**Basket Tea Infuser**](https://bluetea.co.in/products/bucket-tea-infuser) for loose flowers. Serve in our [**Glass Crystal Tea Cups**](https://bluetea.co.in/products/blue-tea-cup-pack-of-2) for an elegant experience.

All seven herbal infusions in your combo work beautifully cold. Hibiscus and Rose are especially refreshing chilled!

Custom Tab Title: Fades Away Stretch Marks | Lightens Scars. Product Footer Description: What is Stretch Mark An expecting woman's pregnancy is one of the happiest times of her life. Pregnancies could also be the most complicated times, as they are generally accompanied by weight gain and stretch marks. It won't be shocking to find stretch marks in healthy adult men and teenagers as stretch marks are caused due to stretching of skin beyond its stretch capability. What are the causes of stretch marks? Skin's excessive and rapid expansion causes indented scars or streaks to appear all over the body. Custom Tab Title: Fades Away Stretch Marks | Lightens Scars. Product Footer Description: What is Stretch Mark An expecting woman's pregnancy is one of the happiest times of her life. Pregnancies could also be the most complicated times, as they are generally accompanied by weight gain and stretch marks. It won't be shocking to find stretch marks in healthy adult men and teenagers as stretch marks are caused due to stretching of skin beyond its stretch capability. What are the causes of stretch marks? Skin's excessive and rapid expansion causes indented scars or streaks to appear all over the body. As a somewhat elastic organ, the skin can adapt well to progressive expansion and contraction. The elasticity of the skin is determined by the body's production of collagen. As a result, if your skin is stretched too far, above the amount of collagen your body can create, ridges known as stretch marks appear. These ridges disrupt the epidermis's surface. Basically, a stretch mark develops when the skin layer immediately beneath the surface rips due to stretching, leaving behind a form of scar. Stretch Mark cream and stretch mark lotion are available in the market to treat stretch marks. What are the causes of stretch marks? Skin's excessive and rapid expansion causes indented scars or streaks to appear all over the body. As a somewhat elastic organ, the skin can adapt well to progressive expansion and contraction. The elasticity of the skin is determined by the body's production of collagen. As a result, if your skin is stretched too far, above the amount of collagen your body can create, ridges known as stretch marks appear. These ridges disrupt the epidermis's surface. Basically, a stretch mark develops when the skin layer immediately beneath the surface rips due to stretching, leaving behind a form of scar. Stretch Mark cream and stretch mark lotion are available in the market to treat stretch marks. These stretch mark creams and stretch mark lotions or stretch mark oils prevent and reduce the appearance of stretch marks. Stretch marks can happen to either men or women and are entirely normal. They appear due to several natural factors including growth spurts, weight gain, pregnancy and genetics.
